# arrayref 0.3.9 provenance

- Upstream: `https://github.com/droundy/arrayref`
- Version: `0.3.9`
- Source revision: `f8d0299d863922db6c409d08098941e833b70d69`
- Published package checksum: `76a2e8124351fda1ef8aaaa3bbd7ebbcb486bbcd4225aca0aa0d84bb2db8fecb`
- License: BSD-2-Clause, retained in `LICENSE`

The source is vendored because the safe 0.3.5 through 0.3.9 registry releases were yanked during
the malicious 0.3.10 and 0.3.11 incident, and the compromised upstream repository is unavailable
to anonymous CI runners. The vendored manifest, license, README, and library source are from the
last pre-incident 0.3.9 commit. They match the previously locked crates.io 0.3.9 package apart from
registry packaging metadata.
